clue.text: Such a vocal piece creates mayhem

indicators.note: a piece of the phrase is a stretch cut out of its letters, so the solution sits inside these words

explanation.surface: A song for voices is so wild it causes chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Havoc is widespread destruction and disorder, a close synonym of mayhem.

clue.text: My German dog's first dish

indicators.note: the dog's word comes first, ahead of the German word

parts.note: a chow is a Chinese breed of dog
mein is German for my

explanation.surface: Someone's German dog gets fed before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Chow mein is a Chinese-style dish of fried noodles, so it is an example of a dish.

clue.text: No justice can prevent you moving

parts.note: no is a negative answer
equity is fairness or natural justice

explanation.surface: A claim that a lack of fairness keeps someone stuck in place.
explanation.walkthrough: Negative equity means owing more on a mortgage than the home is worth, which can stop owners selling up and moving house.
explanation.definitionFit: Owing more than a property's value traps homeowners, since a sale would not clear the mortgage.

clue.text: Among students one must follow fat old historian

indicators.note: the students' piece has to come after the fat and old pieces

parts.note: suet is hard animal fat

indicators.note: among puts the numeral inside the students' union

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students in Britain
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A rule that a student must come after an overweight ancient chronicler.
explanation.definitionFit: Suetonius was a Roman writer known for his biographies of the twelve Caesars, so a historian.

clue.text: Poet's basic assumption

definitions.meaning: the poet John ..., the 's read as is
a French-derived word for a given, a premise taken for granted at the start of an argument or story

explanation.definitionFit: John Donne was an English metaphysical poet; a donné is a basic premise or assumption.

clue.text: Lament what judge may grant to keep partners together

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it inside, so the bail word holds the partners

parts.note: a judge may grant bail to a defendant
E and W, East and West, are partners at the bridge table

explanation.surface: Grieving over how a court might allow a couple to stay together.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewail is to express great sorrow over something, a synonym of lament as a verb.

clue.text: Short of some energy, have engine rig supply current

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the rearranged words come out one letter less than they started
supply is read as the adverb of supple, the words bent into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An engineer with an unreliable power source tells a machine to provide electricity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like a verb but is the adverb from supple, bending ENGINE RIG; 'Short of' says those letters are the solution plus one E.
explanation.definitionFit: Reigning means presently in power or prevailing, as with the current champion.

clue.text: Failure of bullet-hole, perhaps, at the Alamo?

parts.note: a hole is round like the letter O
the Alamo in Texas was a Spanish mission

explanation.surface: A question about whether a bullet hole at the famous Texan fort counts as failure.
explanation.definitionFit: An omission is a failure to do something, a leaving out.

clue.text: By day, sailors have no yen for travel guide

parts.note: Sat is short for Saturday

indicators.note: having no yen means the letter is removed from the sailors' word

parts.note: the navy is the body of sailors
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: Sailors on a day trip are unwilling to go along with travel plans.
explanation.definitionFit: A satnav is an in-car navigation device that guides drivers on their journey.

clue.text: Woodcutters commonly spouted things

indicators.note: common speech drops the h at the start of words

parts.note: hewers chop wood

explanation.surface: Lumberjacks, in everyday talk, ranted on.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewers are large jugs with spouts, so they are things with spouts for pouring.

clue.text: Desire for one large plant at back of cleft in cliff

indicators.note: in puts the tree and the letter together inside the cliff word

parts.note: a scar is a steep rocky cliff

indicators.note: at joins the tree to the letter that follows it

parts.note: a tree is a large plant

indicators.note: the back of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Wanting a big tree growing in a crack at the rear of a rock face.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points to the Tennessee Williams play A Streetcar Named Desire, where Desire is the tram's name, not a longing; 'back of cleft' supplies the T after the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A Streetcar Named Desire makes Desire the name of one tram, so it is an example of one.

clue.text: One's not afraid to have this affliction out in the open

definitions.text: One's not afraid to have this affliction out in the open

parts.words: One's not afraid to have this affliction out in the open
parts.note: a sufferer from the fear of confined spaces is untroubled in open air, and would also speak of the condition openly

explanation.definitionFit: Claustrophobia is the fear of enclosed spaces, so open air holds no terror for sufferers.

clue.text: Good routes going through America, but nothing attractive

indicators.note: going through puts the routes inside the abbreviation for America

parts.note: US is the United States
lines are railway or transport routes

explanation.surface: Good roads cross the USA, yet the scenery has no appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Ugliness is the quality of having no beauty, nothing that appeals to the eye.

clue.text: Slight colouring for one egg on the turn

indicators.note: on the turn means the whole run is turned round

parts.note: eg, for example, means for one
a nit is the egg of a louse

explanation.surface: A hint of colour in an egg that is going off.
explanation.definitionFit: A tinge is a faint trace of colour.

clue.text: Mediator really damaged end of affair

parts.note: honest, used as an exclamation, means truly or really
broke means damaged or broken

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A go-between truly ruined the close of a love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: An honest broker is a neutral intermediary who helps settle disputes.

clue.text: I see about university's rising popularity

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read from bottom to top
the I word goes round the university letter

parts.note: ego is Latin for I
U is short for university
v, vide, is the reference abbreviation for see

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a university's standing is growing.
explanation.walkthrough: Before 'rising' turns it, 'about' puts U into EGO for EUGO, then V follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in vogue means being fashionable and widely popular.

clue.text: They may be trained as scholastics at heart?

indicators.note: trained means shaped or worked into a new form
the heart of the word is everything but its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A suggestion that schoolmen may be formed by central religious teaching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at heart' strips SCHOLASTICS to CHOLASTIC, which 'trained' rearranges; the scholastic philosophers were churchmen, which fits the definition nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: They is a pronoun standing for the members of the Roman Catholic Church named in the solution.

clue.text: Everyone deserting, call on a vessel to abandon resistance

indicators.note: deserting means leaving, so those letters are removed

parts.note: all means everyone
a vein is a blood vessel

explanation.surface: With the crew leaving, an order goes out to a ship to stop fighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deserting' leaves C from CALL once ALL goes; 'vessel' looks nautical but is a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To cave in is to give way or yield, stopping any further opposition.

clue.text: Look up over festival tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means placed above the next piece
in a down clue, up means the word reads upwards

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
Easter is a Christian festival

explanation.surface: Glance above a holiday tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The oleaster is a small tree, also called Russian olive or wild olive.

clue.text: Fungus's form

definitions.meaning: a fungus is, the 's read as is: a furry growth on stale food
a shape or cast into which things are poured

explanation.definitionFit: Mould is a fungal growth and also a hollow shape that gives something its form.

clue.text: Meaning, being under strain, to speak

indicators.note: to speak means these words are said out loud

parts.note: under strain is in tension

explanation.surface: An attempt to put across what is meant while stressed.
explanation.definitionFit: An intention is what someone means to do, their purpose or meaning.

clue.text: Change sides, giving order to revise target

indicators.note: giving order to the words means arranging their letters afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A turncoat issues instructions to change the goal.
explanation.definitionFit: To tergiversate is to switch allegiance or desert a cause, which is a change of sides.

clue.text: Light a few flares as signal to enemy?

indicators.note: flares read as a verb means spreads out wildly, so the letters scatter

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Firing some flares to send a message to the opposing side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flares' looks like the noun lit as a signal, but it is the verb that scatters LIGHT A FEW.
explanation.definitionFit: Waving a white flag signals surrender or a wish to talk truce to the enemy.

clue.text: Maintaining resistance, looks horrified at burning ammunition

indicators.note: maintaining means holding, so the gaping word holds the letter

parts.note: gapes means stares open-mouthed in shock
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
burning means hot

explanation.surface: Under fire, defenders stare in horror at shells in flames.
explanation.definitionFit: Grapeshot is ammunition of small iron balls fired from a cannon.

clue.text: Top dog can't finish off a little lamb

parts.note: number one, written NO I, is the top

indicators.note: unable to finish means the dog's last letter is cut off

parts.note: a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: The leading hound cannot polish off a small portion of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisette is a small round boneless cut of meat, typically lamb.

clue.text: Soldiers run over wearing singlets

indicators.note: wearing means having inside, so the tops wrap round the two letters

parts.note: singlets are sleeveless tops
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Soldiers run across a field in their vests.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops are soldiers, especially in numbers.

clue.text: Arab's small sound system, omitting nothing

definitions.note: the clue's 's reads as is, so the definition is the noun Arab

indicators.note: omitting means leaving out, so the nought is removed

parts.note: audio equipment is a sound system
O is the round figure nought, nothing

explanation.surface: An Arab's compact stereo has nothing missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a native of Saudi Arabia, so an Arab.

clue.text: Murderer conceals origin of blood in compartment

indicators.note: concealing means holding within, so the murderer's name wraps the letter

parts.note: Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A killer hides the source of bloodstains in a small room.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small room or compartment on a ship or plane.
